description: Labelled reader messages for the deterministic language and self-harm guards, covering Singlish, Indian English, code-mixed openers, and non-native English so a code-mixed reader is not refused or missed by a guard tuned on standard English prose.

cases.text: i wan to die already, everything just too much for me now

cases.note: Accepted limitation: this Singlish sentence drops the subject pronoun. Matching bare 'want to die' without 'i' would also catch third-person Singlish uses of the same construction, so the first-person-only guarantee is kept and this dialect elision is not detected.
